prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painting company for every situation — the right one depends on your budget, the size and complexity of the job, timing, and how much finish/repair work you need. I can help you find the best fit. A quick way to decide is to compare a few top-rated local firms on concrete criteria.

Before I look up options for you, a few quick questions:
- Is this for a residence or a commercial property?
- How many rooms / approximate square footage?
- Do you need drywall repair, trim/cabinet painting, or textured-surface work?
- Any timing constraints or a target budget?
- Do you want low-VOC/eco-friendly paint?

What to look for (criteria to call “best” for you)
- Valid license and proof of insurance (liability + workers’ comp)
- Strong local reviews (Google, Yelp, Angie’s List, Houzz) and recent photos of completed interiors
- Written, itemized estimates (labor, materials, prep, cleanup)
- Clear scope: surface prep, number of coats, paint brands and sheen, color-matching
- Guarantees or warranties and a clean final walkthrough
- Good communication and reliable scheduling
- References from recent customers for similar jobs

Red flags
- No written estimate or contract
- Requests for large upfront cash-only payments
- Unwillingness to provide references or show photos of recent work
- Vague answers about paint brands/number of coats

If you want, I can:
- Search for the current top-rated interior painters in St. Louis and give a short list with pros/cons, contact info, and recent reviews; or
- Draft an email/script you can use to request bids from 3–5 companies; or
- Help evaluate estimates you receive.

Which would you prefer? If you want me to find companies, tell me your ZIP code and any of the specifics above.
